overview: Joe Fagan’s first season as manager produced a treble: the First Division, League Cup and European Cup. Liverpool finished three points ahead of Southampton to win a third successive league title. Ian Rush scored 47 goals in all competitions, including 32 in the league.

The League Cup was retained for a fourth consecutive season. After a goalless Wembley final against Everton, Graeme Souness scored the winner in the replay at Maine Road. In Rome, Liverpool drew 1–1 with Roma before winning the European Cup final 4–2 on penalties, Alan Kennedy converting the decisive kick.

Michael Robinson joined from Brighton and John Wark arrived from Ipswich during the season, while David Fairclough left for Lucerne. Brighton again ended Liverpool’s FA Cup run, this time in the fourth round. The campaign finished with Liverpool’s fourth European Cup, completing Fagan’s three-trophy first year.

events.title: The league campaign ends
events.detail: Liverpool drew 1–1 with Norwich City at Anfield in their final league fixture.
